module "Cu_LiftedCalls.dss"

product 0 Material "M_CuLiftedCalls" backend=Graph
  %0 = Reflected[TextureCoordinate](CoordinateIndex=0) : float2 @L15:C17 "UV"
  %1 = Constant(Value=(2)) : float @L16:C27 "Opacity"
  %2 = Reflected[Time]() : float @L8:C15 via L16:C17 "Opacity"
  %3 = Reflected[LinearInterpolate](B=%1, ConstA=0, ConstAlpha=0.5) : float @L9:C19 via L16:C17 "Opacity"
  %4 = Custom[Pulse](UV=%0, Gain=%1, _ds_Pulse_UE0=%2, _ds_Pulse_UE1=%3, Code="// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/IR/Custom/Cu_LiftedCalls.dss\n// DreamShader custom: Pulse line 7\n\n    float T = _ds_Pulse_UE0;\n    float Mixed = _ds_Pulse_UE1                                       ;\n    return sin(UV.x * 8.0 + T) * Mixed;\n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/IR/Custom/Cu_LiftedCalls.dss\n", Description="Pulse", OutputType="Float1") : [Result:float] @L16:C17 "Opacity"
  %5 = Constant(Value=(4)) : float @L16:C44 "Opacity"
  %6 = Reflected[LinearInterpolate](B=%5, ConstA=0, ConstAlpha=0.5) : float @L9:C19 via L16:C34 "Opacity"
  %7 = Custom[Pulse](UV=%0, Gain=%5, _ds_Pulse_UE0=%2, _ds_Pulse_UE1=%6, Code="// Begin DreamShader source: <corpus>/IR/Custom/Cu_LiftedCalls.dss\n// DreamShader custom: Pulse line 7\n\n    float T = _ds_Pulse_UE0;\n    float Mixed = _ds_Pulse_UE1                                       ;\n    return sin(UV.x * 8.0 + T) * Mixed;\n// End DreamShader source: <corpus>/IR/Custom/Cu_LiftedCalls.dss\n", Description="Pulse", OutputType="Float1") : [Result:float] @L16:C34 "Opacity"
  %8 = Multiply(%4, %7) : float @L16:C17 "Opacity"
  %9 = MaterialSink(Opacity=%8) @L13:C1
  sink %9
